description: The tree of planes of a space (docs/spec/groups.md): the stored checks, the smallest extents, the group commands and their refusals, the cards of the planes and the drop resolution. A case reads its layout, the stored form {state, leader, lastCard}, with the options gap, minSize, head and the size of the root plane, then runs its steps; a case with throws refuses its layout with that text.

cases.name: a group of a card holds the card and a new card toward side, takes the slot and the leader mark, and issues the next ids
a group toward bottom splits the child plane on y
a card too small for a group toward side is refused with its size and the size that the group needs

steps.throws: card main cannot hold a group toward right: it is 200x600 and the group needs 240x160

cases.name: the smallest size of a group card is the smallest extent of its child plane plus the gap, and the head height on y
a close that leaves one card in a group replaces the group card with that card in its slot with its leader mark
a close of a group card closes every card of its child plane
a dissolve puts the lines of the child plane into the span of the group card, keeps the ids and passes the leader of the child plane
